result:
PR #393 has both fixes, both device tests passed, CI is green on the current head (329df5e32d), and the PR is out of draft.

**Why the first attempt didn't finish:** it stopped to wait for the automatic arms job to post verdicts on #284, #315 and the PR. The device runs finished at about 07:09 PDT, but no verdict was ever posted, so nothing restarted the lane. This time I read the four result folders myself; every row's status is `ok`.

| issue | device | test | before | after | differing pixels |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #284 anisotropy | nova | Anisotropy-2 / 4 / 8 | 15,496 / 21,981 / 22,617 | 116 / 3,313 / 6,003 | down 99% / 85% / 73% |
| #315 BRDF | thor | three BRDF tests | 614 each | 0 each | now pixel-exact |

- **Verdicts:** both predictions pass every registered check (86 of 86 and 74 of 74). No test outside the predicted ones changed, including Anisotropy-1, the texture-filter suites and lane.tiecode282's tie-rule tests. #284 needed each level to improve by at least half, and all three do. At x4 and x8 the result is a little worse than the offline estimate (2,488 and 5,444), but the prediction stated those as a bound, not exact values.
- **Master merge:** I merged the current master (a5b5b628f2) after the device runs. It changes none of `psh.c`, `psh.h` or either `texture.c`, so I did not re-run the device tests. The only conflict was the generated `docs/testing/nv2a_index.json`, which I rebuilt; it passes its staleness check, and the pre-push checks (`preflight.sh`) pass.
- **Reported:** verdicts are posted on #284, #315 and PR #393, and `docs/lanes/pshaniso284/NOTES.md` records them plus why the first attempt stalled.
- **Still open:** PR #379 (tiecode282) hasn't been merged into master yet. Until it is, the PR's diff against master also shows #379's files; the PR body says so.

The Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in claude.ai's connector settings before they can be used. This lane doesn't need them.
